opening.argument: The speaker identifies his participation as personal history, saying, "I've had my strong block nodes, well my first strong node, since November 28th, 2021." The video then turns to a concrete wallet procedure: "Here's the part of the video where i tell you how to pay less fees," followed by the direction to "set your max fee in GUI." He explains that the same process works in MetaMask. Although he discusses taking profits and withdrawing STRONG, he presents returns and market movements as uncertain personal speculation, not guaranteed profit. The viewer-facing action is setting transaction fees for withdrawals or maintenance payments, not being asked to invest or send money to the creator.
